body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Clipcomm(www.clipcomm.co.kr), a Bluetooth specialist, made a display of its advanced technology and design as a global Bluetooth brand at CES 2008.
Through this show, the company unveiled ‘BS-H100’, its analog telephone adapter enabling existing telephone to use Bluetooth headset.
The company also presented Bluetooth handsfree car kit composed of solar panel that allows you to use it for a long time without separate charge. It has been exporting to Europe market.
Besides, it presented its Bluetooth mono headset ‘HCM-100’. By adopting DSP technology, it offers clear sound quality while minimizing surrounding noise.

A source of this company said that “CES 2008 was a place where Clipcomm recognized as a global Bluetooth brand,” and “our Bluetooth products which consists of various lineup as well as OEM products provided for global mobile vendor could be an opportunity for us to boost our brand image as a Bluetooth specialist,” he added.
